actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Amazon SES action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Amazon SES connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: create_object
actions.title: Create object
actions.description: Create an object in Amazon SES
actions.help: First select the object you would like to create. After selecting the object, fill in any relevant input fields related to that object.

actions.name: delete_object
actions.title: Delete object
actions.description: Delete an object in Amazon SES
actions.help: First select the object you would like to delete. After selecting the object, fill in any relevant input fields related to that object.

actions.name: get_object
actions.title: Get object
actions.description: Get an object in Amazon SES
actions.help: First select the object you would like to get. After selecting the object, fill in any relevant input fields related to that object.

actions.name: list_object
actions.title: List object
actions.help: First select the object you would like to list. After selecting the object, fill in any relevant input fields related to that object.

actions.name: send_bulk_email
actions.title: Send bulk email
actions.description: Send emails to multiple destinations via Amazon SES
actions.help: Select the template of the email you want to send. Then fill in any relevant input fields related to the email.

input.name: template_list
input.label: Template
input.hint: Select a template to send email.

actions.name: send_email
actions.title: Send email
actions.description: Send email to clients via Amazon SES
actions.help: Select the content type of the email you want to send. Then fill in any relevant input fields related to the email

input.name: content_type
input.label: Content type
input.hint: Select the content type. You can send either a simple or template message.

actions.name: update_object
actions.title: Update object
actions.description: Update an object in Amazon SES
actions.help: First select the object you would like to update. After selecting the object, fill in any relevant input fields related to that object.
